shots.narrativePurpose: Give the audience one hero object before explaining the system.
shots.startState: The subject is present but incomplete.
shots.mainAction: The subject completes one physical or spatial action.
shots.endState: The subject lands in its final readable state.
shots.cameraPlan: A deliberate push, track, orbit, or locked reading view; never ambient drift.
shots.materialRule: Use the project-specific material behavior from DESIGN.md.
shots.transitionOut: Name the state or object that carries into the next shot.
shots.antiPattern: Do not turn the opening into a multi-card entrance or detached title slate.

shots.narrativePurpose: Make the mechanism read as a physical system rather than a list of features.
shots.startState: Three fragments are separate but visibly related.
shots.mainAction: The rail expands and the fragments travel into one destination.
shots.endState: The system has one readable, resolved direction.
shots.cameraPlan: A calm reading view that leaves the moving route legible.
shots.materialRule: Use the project-specific material behavior from DESIGN.md.
shots.transitionOut: The resolved destination carries the viewer into the closing identity.
shots.antiPattern: Do not replace the system with a static grid or numbered cards.

shots.narrativePurpose: Leave one memorably resolved system state.
shots.startState: The destination is present but not yet the visual identity.
shots.mainAction: The system quiets around the destination and its label takes ownership of the frame.
shots.endState: The destination holds as the only final reading target.
shots.cameraPlan: Lock the final framing after the action; avoid a drifting tail.
shots.materialRule: Use the project-specific material behavior from DESIGN.md.
shots.antiPattern: Do not end with a detached CTA card or a repeated title slate.
